answer: An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The karst schedule is applied in pigment and tide makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4909 identities would post 2906 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
